servers.name: filesystem
servers.description: Secure file operations with configurable access controls. Exposes read, write, list, search, and move tools scoped to one or more allowed directories.

servers.name: postgres
servers.description: Read-only PostgreSQL access with schema inspection. Lets MCP clients run SELECT queries, list tables, and explore column types without write risk.

servers.name: fetch
servers.description: Retrieves content from URLs and web pages. Supports HTML-to-markdown conversion and raw content extraction for use in AI workflows.

servers.name: github
servers.description: Interact with GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and code. Enables reading files, searching code, creating issues, and managing PRs through the GitHub API.

servers.name: sqlite
servers.description: Read and write a local SQLite database. Exposes tools for running SQL queries, listing tables, and inspecting schema against a file on disk.

servers.name: puppeteer
servers.description: Browser automation and web scraping using Puppeteer. Supports navigating pages, clicking elements, filling forms, taking screenshots, and extracting page content.

servers.name: slack
servers.description: Send and read messages in Slack workspaces. Supports posting to channels, reading conversation history, and looking up users and channels via the Slack API.

servers.name: brave-search
servers.description: Web and local search powered by the Brave Search API. Returns organic results, news, and location-based data without tracking.

servers.name: notion
servers.description: Read, search, create, and update Notion pages and databases. Connects to your Notion workspace via an internal integration token and exposes the Notion API to AI assistants.

servers.name: linear
servers.description: Interact with Linear projects, issues, and teams. Supports creating, updating, and searching issues through the Linear GraphQL API.

servers.name: stripe
servers.description: Manage Stripe payments, customers, subscriptions, and invoices. Enables AI assistants to interact with the Stripe API for billing and payment operations.

servers.name: hubspot
servers.description: Access and manage HubSpot CRM data including contacts, companies, deals, and tasks. Uses a private app access token to connect to your HubSpot account.

servers.name: airtable
servers.description: Read and write Airtable bases, tables, and records. Enables AI assistants to query, create, and update rows in Airtable through the Airtable API.

servers.name: sentry
servers.description: Access Sentry issues, errors, and projects. Lets AI assistants retrieve stack traces, analyze errors, and query events through the Sentry API.

servers.name: shopify
servers.description: Manage Shopify store data including products, orders, customers, and inventory. Connects to a store's Admin GraphQL API using a custom app access token.

servers.name: gitlab
servers.description: Interact with GitLab repositories, issues, merge requests, and code. Supports file operations, branch management, and project management through the GitLab API.
